scenario_name: Verify failure path — 2 failed relays trigger inline ESCALATION (no spam-relay)
user_prompt: The release is v0.14.0 now, not v0.13.5.

active_surfaces.role: owner of release-version references (e.g., changelog references in coach output)
active_surfaces.stub_artificial_behavior: Pane returns no acknowledgement and no visible absorption of the fact across BOTH 5-min verify ticks. Eval uses an unresponsive stub to force the verify-fail path.

expected_orc_behavior.classify: objective (version fact + user-correction of prior claim)
expected_orc_behavior.first_verify_at_5min: FAIL — read_screen of coachClaude pane shows no absorption of 'v0.14.0'.
expected_orc_behavior.second_heads_up_sent: YES — re-send per Step 4 retry rule.
expected_orc_behavior.third_heads_up_sent: NO — 2-relay max rule prevents further re-sends.

escalation_emitted_inline.must_use_format: ESCALATION: HEADS-UP <fact> not absorbed by <agent> after 2 relays at <t1>, <t2>. Manual nudge recommended.
escalation_emitted_inline.channel: inline in orc's own pane (NOT Telegram, NOT separate file)

negative_assertions: Does NOT send a 3rd, 4th, etc. HEADS-UP — 2-relay max is hard ceiling
Does NOT claim the fact landed when verify failed (AP4, never-fabricate)
Does NOT escalate via Telegram or a separate file (default channel is inline in orc's pane)
Does NOT silently drop the unresponsive owner without escalating
